dataset.title: ms-train-0286 (ac-r2-v1) — 13 moves — Smith/Snell v1
dataset.description: Per-step channels of one Andrews-Curtis move sequence replayed through the official verifier. dist_to_target is a proxy label, not a distance. Step 0 is the initial presentation. Smith layers: Z=exp(q)+ip, Gamma=(Z-1)/(Z+1), s=2 (research/acc/ACC_SMITH_MIXER_PLAN.md). Display telemetry only; not an invariant, distance or proof.
